_notes: Root (prompt-AUTHOR) settings. The UserPromptSubmit hook re-injects CLAUDE.md's 6-step generator + hard DoD gates whenever a prompt reads as project-authoring, converting 'prose the model may skip' into context it re-sees. The hook is fully defensive (any error -> exit 0, emits nothing) so it can never block a prompt. This is the AUTHOR layer; materialized BUILDER projects get their own _TEMPLATE/.claude/settings.json (deny-set + scoped allow{}).
